description: 深棕色长发披散，穿浅蓝色针织上衣，一侧可见大圈耳饰，胸前有斜向的深色带状物。画面为接近正面的上半身近景。光线偏暗，下半身未入镜。
description_en: Long dark-brown hair is worn loose. A light-blue knitted top, a large hoop earring on one visible side, and a dark diagonal band across the chest are visible in a nearly frontal upper-body close-up. The lighting is dim, and the lower body is outside the frame.

subjects.description: 深棕色长发披散，穿浅蓝色针织上衣，一侧可见大圈耳饰，胸前有斜向的深色带状物。画面为接近正面的上半身近景。光线偏暗，下半身未入镜。
subjects.description_en: Long dark-brown hair is worn loose. A light-blue knitted top, a large hoop earring on one visible side, and a dark diagonal band across the chest are visible in a nearly frontal upper-body close-up. The lighting is dim, and the lower body is outside the frame.

limitations: 光线偏暗，可能影响发色及衣着颜色判断；下半身未入镜。
头发和斜向带状物遮挡部分上衣，不能完整判断衣着结构。
输入为包含照片的手机截图，照片以人物为主体；统计使用避开手机界面和黑边的区域。
头部和人物区域由 Agent 粗略估计，可能混入背景；没有使用检测器或分割模型。
统计仅保留有损全局计数或加权和，不保留原图、像素、区域定位坐标或空间布局，不生成生物识别模板。
各张图的 p001 仅在该图内有效，不表示已经核验跨图人物身份。
外观描述和图像统计不证明人物记录中的行为、评价或证据等级。
limitations_en: Dim lighting may affect judgments of hair and clothing color; the lower body is outside the frame.
Hair and the diagonal band obscure parts of the top, limiting assessment of its full structure.
The inputs are mobile screenshots containing photographs centered on a subject. Statistical regions avoid the phone interface and black margins.
Head and visible-person regions are coarse Agent estimates and may include background; no detector or segmentation model was used.
Only lossy global counts or weighted sums are retained. Original images, pixels, region coordinates, spatial layout, and biometric templates are not stored.
Each p001 is local to its own image and does not confirm identity across images.
Appearance descriptions and image statistics do not establish the behavior, evaluations, or evidence grades in the person record.
